caseName: Vickroy v. United States Department of the Navy
caseNameFull: Vickroy v. United States Department of the Navy, Long Beach Naval Shipyard

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 9th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
